name: CDF
summary: CDF operated at the Fermilab Tevatron, Batavia, Illinois. This historical general-purpose hadron-collider experiment published collaboration papers explicitly targeting dark matter.
detection_principle: A monojet with large missing transverse energy tags invisible pair production through initial-state radiation; mediator or effective-interaction models translate this to production and scattering cross-section limits.

status.label: Dedicated dark-matter analysis of historical Tevatron data published in 2012

results.summary: The monojet plus missing-transverse-energy sample is compatible with background, constraining dark-matter production and interaction models.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
